newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sega shares ask-only after revised profits outlook.
newsitem.headline: Sega shares ask-only after revised profits outlook.

text.p: Shares in Sega Enterprises Ltd were ask-only in Monday morning trade, depressed by a downward revision in its group earnings forecast late last week, brokers said.
As of 0041 GMT the shares were ask-only at 3,800 yen, after the shares were last traded at 4,050 yen on Friday.
The Tokyo bourse halted trade in the issue on Friday because of unclear information about whether the company would revise its earnings forecast.

Sega later said that it expected group current profits of 11 billion yen in 1996/97, down from its November forecast of 27 billion yen, and a group net profit of 5.3 billion yen, down from its previous forecast of 10 billion yen.
